description: This file contains functions and logic for managing asset depreciation, asset scrapping, and related accounting entries within an ERP system, including creating journal entries, calculating accounts, and handling asset disposal and restoration.

methods.name: post_depreciation_entries
methods.description: Triggers the posting of depreciation entries for assets up to a specified date, if automatic booking is enabled.

methods.name: get_depreciable_assets
methods.description: Retrieves a list of assets eligible for depreciation as of a given date.

methods.name: make_depreciation_entry
methods.description: Creates journal entries for depreciation of a specific asset on a given date.

methods.name: get_depreciation_accounts
methods.description: Fetches the relevant depreciation, accumulated depreciation, and fixed asset accounts for an asset.

methods.name: get_credit_and_debit_accounts
methods.description: Determines the correct credit and debit accounts based on the root type of the depreciation expense account.

methods.name: scrap_asset
methods.description: Processes the scrapping of an asset, creating a journal entry and updating asset status.

methods.name: restore_asset
methods.description: Restores an asset from a scrapped state, canceling the associated journal entry and updating status.

methods.name: get_gl_entries_on_asset_regain
methods.description: Generates general ledger entries for asset regain (recovery) scenarios.

methods.name: get_gl_entries_on_asset_disposal
methods.description: Generates general ledger entries for asset disposal scenarios.

methods.name: get_asset_details
methods.description: Retrieves detailed account and depreciation information for an asset.

methods.name: get_profit_gl_entries
methods.description: Adds profit or loss entries to GL entries based on asset sale or disposal.

methods.name: get_disposal_account_and_cost_center
methods.description: Fetches the disposal account and depreciation cost center for a given company.
